Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry about The Cashew House for two guests from 4 to 8 May (four nights).

I've passed your request to our reservations team, and someone will get back to you shortly with availability and the exact price for your dates.

If you have any questions in the meantime, feel free to reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Palmgrove Stays
Guest Relations

Hi there,

Thank you for your enquiry about Villa Sol for your group of 10 from 5 to 9 January 2027.

Villa Sol can comfortably accommodate your group size. One of our reservations team will check availability for those dates and send you the exact pricing and booking details within the next few hours.

If you have any questions in the meantime, feel free to reply to this email.

Warm regards,
The Palmgrove Stays Team

Hi there,

Thank you for getting in touch! We'd be happy to help you find a villa for your group of 3.

To check availability and send you an accurate quote, could you let us know your preferred dates (check-in and check-out)?

Once we have that, someone from our team will confirm what's available and share the exact price with you.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
The Palmgrove Stays team

Hi! A 60-night workation from 7 Nov to 6 Jan sounds great. We do offer long-stay rates for bookings over 28 nights. Which villa were you interested in, or would you like us to recommend one? Someone from our team will then confirm availability and share the exact pricing for your dates.

Hi there,

Congratulations on your engagement! We'd be happy to help with your celebration at Villa Sol from 9–11 November with 6 guests staying over.

Because you're expecting around 15 guests total for the dinner, we'll need manager approval for the event and to confirm pricing for the additional day visitors. Villa Sol's standard rate applies to the 6 overnight guests, but hosting 9 additional guests for the dinner may involve an event supplement.

Could you share a bit more about the timing and setup you have in mind? One of our team will then check availability and come back with the exact cost.

Warm regards,
Palmgrove Stays Reservations

Hi there,

I've passed your request to our reservations team, and someone will get back to you shortly with availability and the exact price for your dates.

If you have any questions in the meantime, feel free to reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Palmgrove Stays
Reservations Team

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry about hosting a yoga retreat at Villa Sol from 10 to 12 January, with 6 overnight guests and around 40 attendees in total.

Because this involves a larger gathering beyond standard occupancy, we'll need our manager to review the request and confirm whether Villa Sol can accommodate your event safely and comfortably.

Could you share a bit more detail about your plans? Specifically:

• Timing of daily sessions (arrival/departure hours for day guests)
• Any specific space or facility needs
• Parking or access requirements

Once we have this, someone from our team will get back to you within 24 hours with availability and pricing.

Warm regards,
Palmgrove Stays Reservations

Thank you for reaching out about your SEO and Google Ads services.

We're not looking to bring on new marketing partners at the moment, but I appreciate you thinking of Palmgrove Stays.

Wishing you all the best with your business.

Warm regards,
The Palmgrove Stays team

Hi there,

Thank you for getting in touch about Monsoon Cottage for three nights from 21st November.

You've picked a great spot — the cottage is a short walk from Ashwem Beach and close to some excellent cafés and beach shacks.

Let me check availability for your dates and work out the exact price for two guests. Someone from our team will get back to you within a few hours with confirmation and next steps.

Looking forward to hosting you both in Goa.

Warm regards,
Reservations Team
Palmgrove Stays

Hi! We'd be happy to help with a 3-night stay for your family of three. Which dates were you looking at? Once we have those, someone from our team will check availability across our villas and get back to you with options and pricing.

Hi there,

To check availability and share the rate for those dates, could you let me know how many guests will be staying?

Once I have that, someone from our team will get back to you with confirmation and the exact price. Our rates are set according to the season and villa occupancy, and any applicable offers will already be reflected in the quote we send.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Palmgrove Stays Reservations

Hi there,

You can see all four on our website, or if you'd like a recommendation based on what you're looking for, just let me know.

Once I hear back, I'll confirm what's available and share the total price.

Warm regards,
Palmgrove Stays reservations team

Hi there,

• Your preferred move-in date (or the month you're looking at)
• How many guests will be staying
• Roughly how long you're planning to stay

Once I have that, someone from our team will get back to you with availability and a quote tailored to your dates.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
The Palmgrove Stays team
